children: gave back part of its rebound after a sharp drop, Pieverse continued to rally, climbing more than 80% over the past week. The token hit a record high after unveiling security features for AI agents.

According to crypto market data platform CoinGecko on November 22, Pieverse traded at $3.65 as of the time of writing, up 20.7% from 24 hours earlier. It has gained 83.6% over the past seven days and 245.7% over the past 30 days. The token rose as high as $3.75 intraday, setting a fresh all-time high. Its market capitalization was estimated at about $1 billion.

The recent rally coincided with an expansion of security features for its AI agent service. Pieverse's newly introduced "Confidential Agents" is designed to protect conversations, files, memory and credentials stored in its in-house service, "Purr-Fect Claw." The company is currently offering the early service to invited users.
On its official X account, Pieverse said it had expanded protection beyond wallets to cover agent memory, messages and stored data.

Pieverse develops infrastructure that allows users to direct AI agents to handle crypto trading and asset management through messenger apps such as KakaoTalk and Line. It also offers functions that let agents execute on-chain transactions through wallets, exchange services with other agents and settle payments.

This month, the project also announced a strategic partnership with Four.Meme, a BNB Chain-based token issuance platform. The plan is to combine AI agent infrastructure with the token issuance ecosystem. Detailed service formats and a launch timeline were not disclosed.

Price volatility also widened during the rally. Based on CoinGecko data, Pieverse traded between $2.84 and $3.75 over the past 24 hours, marking a gain of about 32% from the session low to the high. Trading volume over the same period reached about $47.41 million.

title: Pieverse Jumps 83.6% in a Week, Hits Record High After AI Agent Security Rollout
